BJP to Launch Nationwide 'Seva Pakhwada' Event

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is organizing a nationwide 'Seva Pakhwada' (Service Fortnight) event starting September 17. This initiative coincides with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's completion of 25 years in public office. The event aims to mark this milestone through public service activities.
